## File: vllm-project_vllm/examples/speech_to_text/lid/openai_lid_client.py

Prompts

```
['run the fire red lid cli to identify language of audio files using vllm', 'create a function that identifies the spoken language of an audio file using the openai sdk', 'create a function that identifies the spoken language of an audio file using raw http requests', 'create a function that identifies the spoken language of an audio file using the streaming transcription endpoint', 'review the main function that processes audio files and prints language identification results in a table']
```

Usage

```
{'run_language_id_cli': 'run the fire red lid cli to identify language of audio files using vllm', 'identify_language_with_openai_sdk': 'create a function that identifies the spoken language of an audio file using the openai sdk', 'identify_language_with_raw_http': 'create a function that identifies the spoken language of an audio file using raw http requests', 'identify_language_streaming': 'create a function that identifies the spoken language of an audio file using the streaming transcription endpoint', 'review_main_function': 'review the main function that processes audio files and prints language identification results in a table'}
```
